title: singular Context Provenance Graph (append-only JSONL line)
description: One line of the append-only JSONL corpus under .singular-state/graph/ — either a node record (nodes.jsonl) or an edge record (edges.jsonl). PURE PROJECTION: derived from the event log, decision records, gate results, critiques, and ledgers; rebuildable from scratch and never authored directly by a model. Fail-closed: closed objects (additionalProperties:false); every node carries evidenceClass (authoritative|claim) and provenance (source record path + content hash). Mirrors schemas/plan-critique.v0.schema.json.

provenance.description: Where this projected record came from. The source record path + its content hash make every graph line traceable to host state and let a rebuild verify byte-identity.

sourcePath.description: Repo- or state-relative path of the durable source record the projector read (e.g. an event-log line file, a critique record, a gate-result, a commit ref).

contentHash.description: sha256 digest of the source record's canonical content — the stable identity a deterministic rebuild reproduces.

recordType.description: Optional S0-S5 source record/event type this line projects from (see docs/context-build-plan/graph-event-mapping.md).

node.description: A node record — one line of nodes.jsonl.

id.description: Stable node id: hash of the source record identity (assigned by the projector; deterministic on rebuild).

type.description: Node-type taxonomy — the complete S0-S5 semantic vocabulary.

evidenceClass.description: authoritative ONLY for host-verified records (gate results, commits, scope/secret scans); claim for every model-authored statement.

label.description: Optional human-readable summary for the node.

attributes.description: Optional projected key/values from the source record (e.g. verdict, severity, status). Never a substitute for provenance.

edge.description: An edge record — one line of edges.jsonl. Directed from `from` to `to`.

id.description: Stable edge id: hash of (from, type, to) source identity (deterministic on rebuild).

type.description: Edge-type taxonomy — the complete S0-S5 relational vocabulary.

attributes.description: Optional projected key/values for the edge (e.g. disposition, finding id).
